title: Stereographic
summary: STEREOGRAPHIC, STEREOGRAPHICAL, adjective [from stereography.] Made or done according to the rules of stereography; delineated on a plane; as a stereographic chart of the earth.

inlines.v: STEREOGRAPHIC, STEREOGRAPHICAL, adjective [from stereography.] Made or done according to the rules of stereography; delineated on a plane; as a stereographic chart of the earth.
